title: Assessment
description: AI candidate conclusion for ONE rule (TECH_SPEC §7.4, refined by B03). This is a proposal, never an audited fact: grounding validation runs after schema validation, and nothing becomes a Finding until Go persists it. Contract refinements vs the TECH_SPEC example: evidence_refs carry normalized locators (the Magic Moment needs them), and the mapping rule_id -> rule code (not DB id) is explicit (R-10).

then.description: PASS/WARN/FAIL must cite at least one evidence item; a conclusion without evidence is UNKNOWN (US-03: insufficient_evidence). Schema-enforced so fabricated conclusions fail validation before grounding even runs.

rule_id.description: The assessed rule's business code. Must exist in the rule set bound to this run; unknown codes are rejected by grounding (Go), not silently dropped. Never the database rule id.

status.description: assessment_status axis (see contracts/state-machines.md). UNKNOWN is the honest answer for insufficient/contradictory evidence and must never be pushed into a forced PASS/FAIL (PRD §9 No Fake Certainty).

severity.description: Candidate severity, usually the rule's severity_default. Reviewers may override via edit; scoring never multiplies severity into weights (ADR-0002).

evidence_refs.description: Evidence citations. Every evidence_id must exist in the job's input manifest; the grounding stage drops or downgrades conclusions citing unknown ids (they are data-integrity failures, not findings).

observation.description: What was literally observed in the cited evidence (observed_fact). Must be separable from reason (inference).

reason.description: Why this status follows from the observation, in terms of the rule's description. Inference, not observation.

recommended_fix.description: Draft remediation suggestion. Non-normative; humans own the fix plan.

confidence.description: Model self-reported confidence in [0,1]. A triage hint for reviewers only; scoring ignores it (ADR-0002 §2.4).

needs_human_review.description: Model's request for human review. The binding review requirement comes from the rule's review_required flag, not from this field.

evidence_id.description: UUIDv7 of an evidence item in THIS run's input manifest. Cross-run or cross-project references are forbidden and rejected.

bbox.description: Image bounding box in ORIGINAL-image normalized coordinates: origin top-left, (x,y) the top-left corner, w/h extents, all in [0,1]. Normalization is against the original resolution, NOT the resized upload, so locators survive re-encoding and zooming.

quote.description: Exact text span cited, for type=quote. Must be a substring of the evidence's text; over-long or fabricated quotes fail grounding.
